environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate connecting to Aurora PostgreSQL 14.6 via RDS Proxy. The database cluster has a custom parameter group with 'pgaudit.log = all' and 'shared_preload_libraries = pg_stat_statements,pgaudit'. The database role 'app_reader' is configured with row-level security policies on all tables, but critically the role has pg_read_all_data revoked and ONLY has explicit SELECT granted on the 'products' table. Additionally, the Aurora cluster uses the pg_hint_plan extension and has statement_timeout set to 2000ms. The RDS Proxy connection is pinned to a single-statement transaction mode (SESSION pinning disabled, multiplexing enforced), and the proxy's idle_client_timeout is 60s. The application's DATABASE_URL uses the RDS Proxy endpoint with require_auth=password and sslmode=verify-full.

config.role_grants: GRANT SELECT ON products TO app_reader; -- no other table grants
